name: Kendo-Pro6000-H3-Quaility
readme: Kendo-Pro6000-H3-Quaility uses the full Singularity V2 BF16 checkpoint (66.3 GB) with exactly the same standard MiniMax H3 Ref2VA nodes as Fast V3: UNET loader, Turbo LoRA, reference conditioning, sampler, video/audio VAEs and SageAttention when compatible. Upscale/LTX/RTX VSR nodes are not included. Recommended hardware is an unsliced RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell with 96 GB VRAM and at least 128 GB system RAM. Use a separate persistent volume of at least 200 GB at /workspace. First launch downloads about 90 GB of model files with resume support. Services: Page 3000, Claude MCP 3001, ComfyUI 8188, JupyterLab 8888.
